description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order under Consumer Affairs Authority Act. that the Gaz. Ex. No. 2030/46 of 04.08.2017 in respect of the maximum Retail Price of the Rice to be rescinded.
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order issued under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003, specifically rescinding a previous order regarding maximum retail prices of rice.
